Q009.fact_true: South Korea's GDP per capita grew at an average of roughly 5 percent a year or more over much of the period from the 1960s onward, and growth compounds over 66 years.
Q009.fact_false: Between 1950 and 2016 South Korea's PPP-adjusted real income per person only about doubled twice, because the Korean War and the 1997 crisis erased most of the gains.
